## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Feb 18, 2026 - Jul 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Antong.lv_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "I paid 5 Euros for this app. As I understand, the features were meant to stay. Now, the app is free and all the features I used to have and actually PAID FOR got REMOVED or to precise are now hidden behind a second paywall. It’s not a lot of money but this is this a straight scam, sadly I really liked to use the app but this is plainly stupid. I hope I can get a refund from Apple"
            2. _eyyy helo ther_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "I paid for this, why an ad still popped up?"
            3. _w y_, Jul 9, 2026, 1/5: "paid for Forest plus and still got ads (not the optional ones for extra rewards)"

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Jul 9, 2026 - Jul 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _w y_, Jul 9, 2026, 1/5: "paid for Forest plus and still got ads (not the optional ones for extra rewards)"
            2. _I just wanna read da Bible_, Jul 13, 2026, 3/5: "I really love this app (that I bought years ago), and as a graduate student I used to use it frequently. Recently, I needed a way to re-balance my time, and thought to re-download. Now it’s loaded with tons of ads and requests to purchase premium. It still works, but it’s a bit much and is irksome to use especially considering I paid for it (eg unskippable ad after most sessions?)"

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      11 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 11, 2026 - Jul 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Keith Gold_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "They recently updated the UI, this is how I know they do not use the app themselves, if it’s not broken why change it, please change the app to how it was before this terrible upgrade"
            2. _Rumichi_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "The app has become unusable rubbish and an obvious cash grab. I‘ve been a user for 7 years and am infuriated with the new updates. Stop spending time on a more bubbly aesthetic and instead hire more programmers so the app can actually be used!!!! Example 1: when automatically starting a new session via mindful space, the countdown does not show up on the lock screen Example 2: with the newest update, the UI has become less intuitive (for example finding the countdown option) and the planting with friends feature can only be used when switching to ,,Classic Mode‘‘ in the settings. WELL, there is no such option to be found in the settings! And when you want to search for it in the FAQ portion, the site crashes. It feels like you just push out updates that feel like beta versions and are obviously not polished or even finished and tested. I‘m gonna look for alternative apps, the last few years have been an utter disappointment."
            3. _Mukul Gupta_, Jul 17, 2026, 1/5: "Overtime this has only got more buggy and laggy. Not what I expected after buying the premium subscription."
